audit.summary: Two invalid printed derivations are directly used for core components of Theorem7.6: coefficient-loss conservativity at infinite height, and p-annihilation used in field-equivalence kernel equality. Explicit counterexamples refute the supporting statements; verified local arguments establish the weaker needed conclusions. A separate infinity finite-generation assertion is false outside its actual finite-height downstream use. No counterexample to Theorem7.6 is claimed.
limitations: P1 — Infinite-height annihilator radical is not finitely generated — Counterevidence: Finite height has finitely generated I(p,m). The printed7.4 argument explicitly branches: finite m uses this step, infinity instead requires conservativity. The infinity heart is understood using all finite-length norm varieties, not an undefined infinite-length symbol.

P2 — False equivalence supplies an unsupported core infinity conservativity bridge — Counterevidence: The Tate map does not refute conservativity; the weaker assertion is true. Prop7.1 alone is invoked only in the finite branch, so merely the extraneous equivalence word would be local if disconnected from p17.

P3 — False bare-projector p-annihilation is used in the core field-equivalence derivation — Counterevidence: The required factorized maps contain M(P) or M(R). A degree-p cover remaining anisotropic after these fields lies in Q and transfer proves p kills those tensor-factor objects, so the needed intermediate conclusion is true.
Limitations: Not a formal verification of motivic category foundations or every external construction.

proposition.claim:
sqrt J(U) is finitely generated, without a finite-m restriction.

Flexible characteristic-zero k=C(t1,t2,...), any prime p, m=infinity; U is the compact localized unit in the first anisotropy quotient.

The coefficient-change functor is an equivalence at infinity; later its composite with the weight functor is invoked as conservative.

m=infinity, R=Fp[x] to K(p,infinity)=Fp; bounded numerical-motive complexes over flexible characteristic-zero k.

p kills the identity of the bare complementary Cech projector Xtilde_Q, so prime-to-p l can be removed.

p=2, any finite m>=1, flexible k=Q(t1,t2,...), E=F=k(sqrt2), P=R=Spec E; Q comprises varieties whose function fields strictly dominate E.

repair.content:
Restrict finite-generation argument to finite m with flexible hypothesis made explicit; separate zero-MGL-motive whole-ring annihilator case.

Use coefficientwise numerical CH/p polynomial extension, finite-object positive-degree kernel nilpotence, surjectivity on Hom, lift a target contracting homotopy h, invert q=dh+hd=1-delta via nilpotence, contract by hq^{-1}. This proves conservativity exactly where required.

Replace bare-projector annihilation by p id=0 on M(P) tensor Xtilde_Q and M(R) tensor Xtilde_Q; finite-cover pullback/pushforward supplies it and permits removal of l.
